scan.instruction: Position the document inside the marked area
scan.permission: We need the camera to scan the invoice

errors.noTextLayer: This PDF has no selectable text (it looks scanned). Please send a digitally generated PDF.
errors.noItems: We couldn't find any items in this document. Check that it is an invoice or quote.
errors.ocrUnavailable: Photo recognition needs a development build (it does not work in Expo Go). Use "Attach PDF" for now.
errors.permissionDenied: We need your permission to access photos.
errors.unsupportedType: We only take a PDF or a JPEG photo. Take the photo in the app or pick another file.
errors.offline: No internet connection. Sending needs a network — try again once it is back.
errors.tooLarge: This file is over 15 MB. Take the photo again or send a smaller PDF.
errors.duplicateFile: This document was sent before. Open the existing entry instead of creating another.
errors.notProvisioned: Your account is not finished yet. Sign out and sign in again.
errors.uploadRejected: The upload was refused. Please try again.
errors.notConfirmed: The file did not arrive complete. Please send it again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong while sending. Try again in a moment.
